answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A vineyard association tenure with vintage production logs works as the gate: vintages produced under one association for years. The price is per head, and the spiral test proves it: Each of 124 aliases needs its own production logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The ember trail is public, the fable check is cheap to run, and a farm of 124 aliases pays 124 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
